senses.gloss: प्रथ् (I) vi. 1Ā (pres. प्रथते) 1. To become well-known, to become famous, तीर्थं पावनं भुवि पप्रथे R.xv.101, K.S.v.7, Megh.i.24; 2. to increase; 3. to spread abroad, तथा यशोऽस्य प्रथते M.xi.15; 4. to appear, to arise, श्रमानुत्तासां मदनो नु पप्रथे Kir.viii.53.

प्रथ् (II) vt. or vi. 10U (pres. प्रथयति-ते) 1. To be famous or well-known; 2. to spread abroad, Bt.xvii.160; 3. to evince, to show, to manifest, प्रथयितुं विभुतामभिनिर्मितम् Kir.v.3; 4. to increase, to augment.
प्रथन n. 1. Spreading, spreading out; 2. showing, evincing; 3. throwing, projecting; 4. a place where anything is spread.

प्रथम a. (f. मा) (the nom. pl. m. of this word is either प्रथमे or प्रथमाः) 1. First, foremost, R.iii.44; 2. earliest, most ancient; 3. previous, prior, earlier, R.x.67; 4. chief, principal, most eminent, incomparable, matchless; 5. the third (person) (in gram.).(प्रथमम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) firstly, at first, K.S.vii.24; (2) previously, already, R.iii.68; (3) immediately. at once; (4) before, यात्राये चोदयामास तं शक्तेः प्रथमं शरत् R.iv.24, उत्तिष्ठेत्प्रथमं चास्य चरमं चैव संविशेत् M.ii.194. प्रथमम्-अनंतरम्, ततः or पश्चात् ‘first-afterwards.’)

प्रथम a. (f. मा) (the nom. pl. m. of this word is either प्रथमे or प्रथमाः) 1. First, foremost, R.iii.44; 2. earliest, most ancient; 3. previous, prior, earlier, R.x.67; 4. chief, principal, most eminent, incomparable, matchless; 5. the third (person) (in gram.).(प्रथमम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) firstly, at first, K.S.vii.24; (2) previously, already, R.iii.68; (3) immediately. at once; (4) before, यात्राये चोदयामास तं शक्तेः प्रथमं शरत् R.iv.24, उत्तिष्ठेत्प्रथमं चास्य चरमं चैव संविशेत् M.ii.194. प्रथमम्-अनंतरम्, ततः or पश्चात् ‘first-afterwards.’)
प्रथम-अर्ध m.n. the first half.
प्रथम-आश्रम m. the first of the four stages in the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa, i.e. Brahmacharya.
प्रथम-इतर a. the second.
प्रथम-उदित a. uttered previously, उवाच धात्र्यां प्रथमोदितं वचः R.iii.25.
प्रथम-कल्प m. the best course to follow.
प्रथम-कल्पित a. 1. first in rank; 2. previously devised.
प्रथम-ज a. first born.
प्रथम-तस् ind. 1. at first, firstly; 2. previously; 3. immediately.
प्रथम-दर्शन n. first sight.
प्रथम-दिवस m. the first day, Megh.i.2.
प्रथम-पुरुष m. the third person (according to the European system of grammar).
प्रथम-यौवन n. early youth, the first period of youth.
प्रथम-वयस् n. early age, youth.
प्रथम-विरह m. separation for the first time.
प्रथम-वैयाकरण m. 1. a beginner in grammar; 2. the most excellent grammarian.
प्रथम-साहस m. the first of the three degrees of fine (in law).
प्रथम-सुकृत n. a former kindness.
प्रथा f. Fame, celebrity.
प्रथित a. (f. ता) 1. Increased, extended; 2. published, announced, प्रथितयशसां धावकं सौमिल्लादीनाम् Mal.i.; 3. shown, manifested, evinced; 4. famous, celebrated, renowned, (pp. of प्रथ q.v.).
प्रथित a. (f. ता) 1. Increased, extended; 2. published, announced, प्रथितयशसां धावकं सौमिल्लादीनाम् Mal.i.; 3. shown, manifested, evinced; 4. famous, celebrated, renowned, (pp. of प्रथ q.v.).
प्रथिमन् m. Extension, greatness, magnitude, वंश्या गुणाः खल्वपि लोककांताः प्रारंभसूक्ष्माः प्रथिमानमापुः R.xviii.49.
प्रथिवि f. The earth.
प्रथिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Largest, broadest, (super. of पृथु q.v.).
प्रथिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Largest, broadest, (super. of पृथु q.v.).
प्रथीयस् a. (f. सी) Larger, broader, (compar. of पृथु q.v.).
प्रथीयस् a. (f. सी) Larger, broader, (compar. of पृथु q.v.).
प्रथु a. Wide, wide-spread.
प्रथुक m. Rice parched and flattened.
प्राथमिक a. (f. की) 1. Primary, first, initial; 2. happening for the first time.
प्राथमिक a. (f. की) 1. Primary, first, initial; 2. happening for the first time.
प्राथम्य n. The being first, precedence, priority.
